description: Define a list of sites, based on URL patterns, that can't set cookies. If you don't configure this policy, the global default value from the "DefaultCookiesSetting" policy (if set) or the user's personal configuration is used for all sites. See the "CookiesAllowedForUrls" and "CookiesSessionOnlyForUrls" policies for more information. Note there can't be conflicting URL patterns set between these three policies: - CookiesBlockedForUrls - "CookiesAllowedForUrls" - "CookiesSessionOnlyForUrls" For detailed information on valid url patterns, please see https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?linkid=2095322. * isn't an accepted value for this policy.
